# Dragotchi

A dragon-raising virtual pet for the Flipper Zero that senses the real world.

Raise an egg into a dragon: feed it, play with it, keep it clean and healthy,
discipline it, and let it sleep. **How well you care for it decides who it
becomes** — a radiant white dragon if you raise it well, a grey dragon for
middling care, or a black dragon if you neglect it. Care for an adult
impeccably and it can live forever.

## Hunt the real airwaves

A one-tap **Hunt** makes the dragon sniff the real sub-GHz airwaves
(315/433/868/915 MHz, receive-only) — and where you physically are changes your
luck. Catches are prey (feeds it), treasure (builds a hoard and rank), or eggs
(a hatchery for your next dragon).

## Expeditions

Send the dragon on a timed offline trip — 30 minutes, 2 hours, or 8 hours. It
returns with loot scaled to the journey and a short travel log. Longer trips
risk coming back hurt, but never fatally.

## Signal storm (optional WiFi devboard)

Attach an ESP32-S2 WiFi devboard running the companion reporter firmware and a
hunt in a busy area becomes a **signal storm**: an animated radar screen, better
odds, a guaranteed floor, WiFi-themed catch names, and an exclusive collectible
**storm egg**. The game plays identically with no board attached — it is pure
enrichment.

## Credits
